info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to learn, to read, to study, to recite

examples: 'yaM (japyaM) saptarAtraM prapaWan pumAn paSyati KecarAn' (BA॰pu॰4.8.53). prapaWan=uccEruccArayan. yena yatnena manvAdyErAtmavacanaM prapAWitam (=proktam, aDyApitam). prapAWaka iti tEttirIyasaMhitAdizu granTEkadeSasya saYjYA.
'vedANgAni ca sarvARi kfzRapakzezu sampaWet' (manu॰4.98). sampaWet=paWet. nArTaH samA.
'yajYakarmaRIti kim. sampAWe mA BUt' (pA0 1.2.34 sUtravfttO). sampAWaH svADyAyakAla iti nyAsaH.
'kartari karmavyatihAre' (1.3.15) ityatra pratizeDe hasAdInAmiti vArttikodAharaRe vyatipaWantIti vfttO sTitam. tatra parasparaM paWantItyarTaH.
'sarpasatramiti KyAtaM purARe paripaWyate' (BA0 Adi0 51.6). paripaWyate satrezu maDye paWyate'nukramyate.
'asya lokasya sarvasya yaH praBuH paripaWyate' (BA0 vana0 14192). paripaWyate sarvatra kIrtyate.
'na DarmaH paripAWena Sakyo BArata veditum' (BA0 SAM0 260.3). paripAWa AmnAyaH.
